purpose: 系统空间 UI 三版整体概念图，仅美术方案，不改运行页面。
qualityTier: 未披露；提示词请求最高可用视觉精度

variants.name: 墨漆朱印
variants.prompt:
Create a polished, high-resolution widescreen 16:10 game UI concept screenshot for the Chinese fantasy game system hub. This is a UI redesign study using the supplied references. Reference 1 is the existing game screen: preserve its quiet charcoal/blue-green sanctuary, slender bronze circular ring, camera, overall lighting and spacious composition. Reference 2 is the approved character: preserve exactly her identity, frontal pose, cute chibi proportions, long dark plum hair, red amber eyes, gold flower hairpin, red and gold embroidered hanfu, and both hands holding a red thread. Keep the complete central character visible; do not put buttons over her face, hands or clothes. Improve interface design at highest available visual fidelity: carefully crafted bespoke game art with tactile materials and restrained sakura accents, beautifully readable typography, meticulous highlights and shadows. Draw a full cohesive rendered game screenshot, not a sheet of assets, not a sketch or web dashboard. No phone/browser frame, no labels identifying the design variant.
Composition: one central character taking about 60% of screen height. Small elegant title at top center reading exactly “系统空间”, with a fine cherry blossom twig beneath. Three clearly clickable floating controls spaced vertically on the left, labeled exactly “世界入口”, “轮回记录”, “行囊”. Three on the right, labeled exactly “主神契约”, “系统设置”, “返回主神”. Match each icon to its meaning: gate, scroll, small pouch, thread knot, settings dial, curved return arrow. Only “世界入口” is selected; other controls are subdued but readable. Spacious margins and balanced rhythm. Bottom centered input must have very soft large-radius ROUND corners and a smooth pill-like silhouette, never pointed or angular. Its exact placeholder is “向红妆说些什么…” and at right one small round send control. No additional text, no status counters, no shop/currency UI, no massive opaque panels. Show subtle floating elevation through contact shadows and selective edge light, not bright neon. The hero's face and background should not be redesigned.

ART DIRECTION A — INK LACQUER AND VERMILION SEALS. Build six small circular floating lacquer medallions in a loose arc around the character; the middle pair sit slightly farther outward. Each has a subtly domed satin charcoal-black lacquer surface, a hair-thin aged champagne-gold rim, and carved ivory/gold icon. Place each Chinese label neatly under its medallion. A selected medallion has a deep vermilion lacquer inset, a thin gently luminous red perimeter traced around part of the rim, a tiny raised sakura blossom nestled at lower right and a short fine red cord tassel; keep it dignified, not jewel-encrusted. Inactive medallions matte and quieter. Bottom input resembles an extremely shallow rounded dark lacquer tray, with warm dark translucent center, softly rounded old-gold lip, red silk cord embedded along its lower edge and a small circular vermilion seal for send. A tiny pink-red blossom at the lower left balances the seal. Visually rich, refined restrained Chinese fantasy, low chroma, soft directional light, fine material microtexture; all controls comfortably readable.

ART DIRECTION C — SILK FOLIOS AND BLOSSOM NOTES. Distinct handmade Chinese fantasy interface: on each side, a graceful fine red silk thread loosely connects three small floating SHORT HORIZONTAL folio tabs. Each tab is a dark charcoal paper card with soft rounded corners, gently curved red silk binding on its outer end, very fine warm gold embroidered seams, a tiny embossed pictogram and warm-ivory Chinese label. No long vertical banners. Show subtle layered paper thickness and warm cloth fibers. Selected upper-left “世界入口” folio unfolds one soft corner to reveal a small warm cream silk area, with a modest crimson sakura stamp and a thin warm edge light; all other tabs stay folded, low saturation and readable. Bottom input is a softly unrolled horizontal dark silk writing slip, long and shallow with perfectly round padded ends and continuous smooth curvature, crimson woven edges, barely visible floral jacquard, a little sewn blossom-knot round send button at right. The input center stays dark and calm for readable placeholder, not a large white paper panel. Fine red cord is decorative and never crosses the character. Refined tactile embroidery and paper fibers, intimate and warm without clutter, restrained petal motifs and extremely sparse drifting petals. Keep same dark sanctuary and central character, allowing the UI material palette to carry the difference.
